hooks.command: IN=$(cat); F=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); SID=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('session_id',''))" 2>/dev/null); case "$F" in *.cs|*.axaml) [ -n "$SID" ] && touch "/tmp/qp-dirty-net-$SID"; exit 0;; */macos/QuickProtect/*.swift|*/macos/QuickProtectTests/*.swift) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; [ -n "$SID" ] && touch "/tmp/qp-dirty-$SID"; SL=$(command -v swiftlint || echo /opt/homebrew/bin/swiftlint); [ -x "$SL" ] || exit 0; ERR=$(cd macos && "$SL" lint --quiet "$F" 2>&1 | grep ': error:' | head -10); if [ -n "$ERR" ]; then echo "$ERR" >&2; exit 2; fi

hooks.statusMessage: Verifying QuickProtect (tests + strict lint) before stopping…
